title: Delay selection of newly published packages
goal: Set a source cooldown when adding or updating dependencies, while distinguishing automatic selection from explicit-version restore and floating-reference conflicts.

selectionNotes: Cooldown is source-scoped selection policy, not universal restore exclusion or vulnerability mitigation.
RC2 rejects both tested 1.* and 1.2.* floating references with NU1020; explicit 1.2.0 restores despite being fresh.
Requires a source supplying publication metadata; do not infer production-feed behavior from a folder feed.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Runtime of the selected SDK build/package tooling; this route is catalogued for target 11.

sdk.reason: The documented .NET 11 SDK/MSBuild/NuGet command behavior; exact RC2 verification is recorded separately.

prerequisites: Inspect effective global.json, project imports, shared build files and NuGet configuration before applying the migration.
Use an existing authorized package source for package commands; replace the example.invalid URL. Publication metadata and audit data are source capabilities, not credentials supplied by Playbook.

Build tests verify XML outputs and wave diagnostics, not all historical wave internals.
